title: Dotted ring with chords

techniques.name: Tilted record ring

tilt.label: Tilt
tilt.note: The lab’s tilt: 0 looks down the axis of the record; a few degrees show its turns stacking behind one another. Past 5° the turns close into a coil and the ring is lost.

strands.label: Strands
strands.note: How many strands of the record are drawn, each seeded by one line: 42 make a turn, 126 three, 210 five.

gain.label: Radial gain
gain.note: How far each strand reaches from the ring for its weight.

layer.label: Layer
layer.note: Which of the lab’s four layers draws the ring: dots, path, contours or glow.

recall.label: Recall chords
recall.note: The chords from the newest strand back to the strands it recalls.

techniques.implementation: Dots on a ring are drawn with a soft halo on black; chords and waves sit under the ring as thin lines. Drawn by the source page’s own code; each dial sets one of the page’s own controls or one of the numbers its drawing is built from.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
